title: Mexico Approves 50% Tariffs on Many Chinese Imports
summary: The tariffs will apply to goods from China and other nations. Washington has been pressuring Mexico to move away from dealing with China.

title: Crypto mogul Do Kwon to be sentenced for misleading investors who lost billions in stablecoin crash
summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Cryptocurrency mogul Do Kwon is scheduled to be sentenced Thursday for misleading investors who lost billions when his company’s crypto ecosystem collapsed in 2022.
